def solution():
    # Define variables
    life_expectancy = 75
    mean_years_school = 10
    expected_years_school = 16
    gni_per_capita = 35000

    # Calculate normalized indices
    life_expectancy_index = (life_expectancy - 20) / (85 - 20)
    education_index = (
        (mean_years_school / 15) + (expected_years_school / 18)
    ) / 2
    gni_index = (gni_per_capita - 100) / (75000 - 100)

    # Calculate HDI using the geometric mean
    hdi = (
        life_expectancy_index * education_index * gni_index
    ) ** (1 / 3)

    # Return HDI rounded to three decimal places
    return round(hdi, 3)
